steps.text: Move with WASD or the arrow keys.
Punch the training dummy: J or Z. Keep pressing to chain a combo.
Heavy blow: K or X. It breaks guards but costs energy.
Skills: keys 2 to 5. Each one cools down after use.
Dodge: Space. Nothing can touch you mid-roll.
Guard: hold Shift. Raise it just before a hit to parry.
Stand on a weapon in the yard and press E to pick it up.
Press E again with nothing underfoot to throw it.
Talk to Chief Odo (E) for your first job.
